summary: Tests-first run for issue #5 (replace hand-written API layer with generated OpenAPI Swift client). Authored permanent unit tests in iOS/Tests/ColorMatchingLPSAppTests/OpenAPIGeneratedClientTests.swift exercising the future generated client (module OpenAPIGenerated) against local URLProtocol-stubbed responses for all six surfaces (manifest, recent sheets, capture creation, measurement upload, judgment upload, ranked results) plus an undeclared-404 error path; a sentinel test fails red until the generated target is wired in, and the rest are gated on #if canImport(OpenAPIGenerated) so the existing suite still compiles. Recorded the AC-to-verification mapping and the prose-contract gaps (ranked_results has no response schema, undocumented success status codes, no error envelope, auth out-of-band, title nullability, upload stats key set) in docs/openapi-generated-client-test-plan.md. Limitations: no Swift toolchain in this container (swift: command not found) so tests could not be executed locally; the upstream OpenAPI spec from viamin/color_matching#110 is not fetchable from here (HTTP 404), both recorded in the doc. Implementation criteria are not_run pending the implementation run; authoritative test execution is the CI macOS 'swift test' job.
